product: commentary — no product (a build-in-public note about an ad format for a games app, not an actual ad)
hook: "Building 'Tiktok for games' Arcadeo for this year's Shipaton." — hackathon build announcement.
body: The builder's aim is a non-frustrating ad experience: skippable in 5 seconds, appearing naturally while scrolling games, "not those stupid interactive ads but entertaining video ones"; the lesson is that AdMob doesn't always have fill and mediation must be managed manually.
idea: Interactive/gesture ads are perceived as frustrating by users — the winning ad experience in-feed is skippable, native-feeling video, not forced interaction.
sequencing: The specs (5s skip, natural placement, entertaining video over interactive)
The lesson (AdMob fill gaps, manage mediation yourself)
why_it_works: Reveals the format's user-experience ceiling from the builder's side — even ad-platform builders admit interactive ads feel "stupid" compared to entertaining video, which is a caution signal for the whole format category.
what_to_steal: The UX bar for LC's interactive/gesture concepts: 5-second skip, native placement, entertainment first — interaction must feel like play, never a gate.
